description: Export the calling seller's orders as CSV (Order ID, Product, Buyer, Quantity, Total, Status, Date). Thin adapter over POST /api/seller/orders/bulk-export — orders not owned by the caller are silently skipped. Returns the CSV body as a string plus the suggested filename.

order_ids.description: Order ids belonging to the calling seller (max 200/request). Orders owned by anyone else are skipped.

name: bulk_export_orders
title: Export orders as CSV
